                                                ORDER

        This matter is before the Court on Plaintiff’s Motion to Disqualify Magistrate Judge Ivan D. Davis

Under 28 U.S.C. § 455(b)(4) and § 455(a), and for Priority Determination [Dkt. No. 86] (“Motion”). This

matter can be resolved without oral argument, as such argument would not aid the decisional process.

Upon consideration of Motion, it is hereby

        ORDERED that Plaintiff’s Motion is DENIED AS MOOT. The case has been reassigned to

Magistrate Judge William E. Fitzpatrick.

        ENTERED this 22nd day of October 2026.



                                                                            /s/
                                                                Ivan D. Davis
           Alexandria, Virginia                                 United States Magistrate Judge
